name: agent-router
description: Mod that lists the installed agent types, each with when to use it, in the Agent tool's description in an orchestration session (CLAUDE_ORCHESTRATE set, or the main thread runs the orchestration agent), so new agents get routes without editing it.

enabled.title: Enable the mod
enabled.description: Off removes the routing table from the Agent tool's description. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session. Only an exact false turns it off.

maxAgents.title: Agent types listed
maxAgents.description: The most agent types the table lists; the rest are counted in one line. Whole number, 1 to 100. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session.

descriptionChars.title: Characters per row
descriptionChars.description: The longest when-to-use text on a row, cut at a word boundary with an ellipsis. Whole number, 40 to 1000. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session.

hideAgents.title: Agent types to hide
hideAgents.description: Agent type names to leave out of the table, separated by commas or spaces. Names with characters other than letters, digits and _ . : @ - are ignored; a value over 4096 characters hides nothing. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session.
